task.title: Unmarking a Clause
task.shortdesc: removes Apttus clause properties and returns the text to a static state. If you decide

context.p: Unmarking a clause removes Apttus clause properties and returns the text to a static state. If you decide you want to unmark a clause during the same session in which you marked it, you can use the Doc Clauses pane to remove Apttus clause properties. Note that, if you chose to replace the text with a clause from the library, you cannot choose to unmark the clause, it can only be deleted.

ul.li: You must have marked static text in the agreement document as a clause in the same session using Playbook.
